_comment: PER-REGION DARK LANDS tile of the TWW3 Old World mod parchment, placed by the paired-anchor-dot workflow (the same one validated on the Empire, then Bretonnia and Kislev+Norsca, 2026-08-14/15). The whole-map fit of this source is impossible — it draws different regions at inconsistent scale, so no single warp reconciles it (see the landmark-accuracy wall). Instead the user cropped the Dark Lands out (alpha-erasing everything outside it) and drew 14 matched colour dots on the crop AND on terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png, which IS the canvas/mask frame (8192x3616). The dot centroids, recovered by exact RGB, give 14 source<->canvas correspondences; a thin-plate through them places the tile exactly at every dot. objective=landmarks means NO silhouette fit (the drift-prone stage), just the interpolation. master_shape is the crop's native (h,w) = (2779,1965); the source is the dot-free, alpha-masked crop. This record only PLACES the tile (like the Empire/Bretonnia/Kislev tiles); no geometry is extracted yet.
_comment_lattice: 6x6 over the crop (~327 master px horizontal spacing, ~463 vertical). The 14 dots span the region's coastal/edge extremes (blue at the far-west tip, rose far-east, azure/orange along the north edge, magenta/spring_green/cyan at the south, plus periwinkle SW and salmon SE added in the second pass to anchor the previously dot-sparse southern band); the lattice regularises the thin-plate and captures its affine trend out to the crop corners, where it extrapolates beyond the dot hull. Global-affine residual of the 14 pairs is mean 23 / max 68 px (blue, the west coastal tip) — non-affine curvature the thin-plate absorbs exactly at each dot.
_comment_landmarks: source px = dot centroid in the crop's own 1965x2779 frame (x,y); canvas px = the SAME dot's centroid read straight off terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png (= canvas space, no globe-fit indirection). Paired by the colour the user drew (pure marker palette: every channel in {0,127,255}). All 14 colours present in both frames as a single 12-px component each; the globe's stray (127,0,0) specks are natural pixels, absent from the crop, and correctly excluded. periwinkle and salmon were added in a second pass to anchor the southern band. These ARE the fit (not a held-out check) for objective=landmarks.

record.notes: PROVISIONAL. A DENSE Old World boundary network confined to the Dark Lands — the whole-source fit is defeated by its inconsistent inter-region scale, so this per-region carve is the way in. CONSUMED as an ink_bridged boundary source (generate_state_labels.py), clipped to its alpha>0 footprint, at boundaries precedence 113 — above IE (100) and tww3_colored (95) so its lines win inside its own footprint only. Contributes NO coastline (the mask remains the sole authority, user decision #1); coastline/relief precedence stay provisional lows. PROVISIONAL until the user accepts the diagnostic render. MACHINE-FITTED; re-derive from the seed, do not hand-edit.
